title: Great way to visit Town
text: We had an absolutely fantastic time on this tapas tour! Everything was great, from the delicious food and drinks to the atmosphere and the stories behind each stop. Pierre was an amazing guide, super friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate. He made the experience really fun and enjoyable, and we felt like we were discovering Barcelona like locals. We laughed, ate well, learned a lot, and had such a wonderful time. Highly recommend this tour, especially if you’re lucky enough to have Pierre as your guide!
